name: yandex-metrica
description: Yandex Metrica web analytics via the local mcp-yandex-metrica npm server: counters, goals, traffic and conversion reports. Sign in with Yandex right in the chat; a ready-made token is optional (for CI). Requires Node.js 20+.

token.title: Yandex Metrica OAuth token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to sign in with Yandex from the chat ("connect Yandex Metrica"). Set only for CI or headless setups; needs metrika:read.

counter_id.title: Default counter ID (optional)
counter_id.description: Metrica counter to use by default; leave empty to let the assistant pick from list_counters
